//: Evidence ledger for catalog.json's `verified` field (#70). Every entry catalog.json marks verified:true must have a matching record here, with a clean passRate and a harnessRef a reviewer can open and check. scripts/validate-catalog.sh enforces the pairing in CI. This is a hand-maintained interim guard, not the CI-generated harness feed DESIGN.md describes (tracked separately in ROADMAP.md's Alpha checklist, tuna-os/tunaOS#910) -- it exists so flipping the boolean alone can no longer pass review or CI.
